# vm-virtio: a virtual machine (no board.json) laid out like real sysfs:
# every /sys/class/net entry is a symlink into /sys/devices, and each NIC's
# device link leads to the virtio device whose driver link names virtio_net.
# ens3 and ens4 are hardware-backed (device link), medium "virtual" from the
# driver; ens3 reports no speed (-1), ens4 10 Gb/s. docker0 is a bridge and
# veth1a2b3c4 the host end of a container's veth: a virtual NIC, reported
# only with VirtualAlways because the host has hardware ports. Its iflink (5)
# happens to equal tailscale0's local ifindex. tailscale0 is a tun device
# (type 65534).
#
# Format: see loadTree in ports_test.go.

-- sys/class/net/ --
docker0 -> ../../devices/virtual/net/docker0
ens3 -> ../../devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:03.0/virtio0/net/ens3
ens4 -> ../../devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:04.0/virtio1/net/ens4
lo -> ../../devices/virtual/net/lo
tailscale0 -> ../../devices/virtual/net/tailscale0
veth1a2b3c4 -> ../../devices/virtual/net/veth1a2b3c4

-- sys/devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:03.0/virtio0/ --
driver -> ../../../../bus/virtio/drivers/virtio_net
uevent=DRIVER=virtio_net\nMODALIAS=virtio:d00000001v00001AF4

-- sys/devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:03.0/virtio0/net/ens3/ --
type=1
ifindex=2
iflink=2
flags=0x1003
carrier=1
carrier_changes=1
operstate=up
speed=-1
duplex=unknown
address=02:00:00:00:05:02
mtu=1500
uevent=INTERFACE=ens3\nIFINDEX=2
device -> ../../../virtio0

-- sys/devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:04.0/virtio1/ --
driver -> ../../../../bus/virtio/drivers/virtio_net
uevent=DRIVER=virtio_net\nMODALIAS=virtio:d00000001v00001AF4

-- sys/devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:04.0/virtio1/net/ens4/ --
type=1
ifindex=3
iflink=3
flags=0x1003
carrier=1
carrier_changes=1
operstate=up
speed=10000
duplex=full
address=02:00:00:00:05:03
mtu=1500
uevent=INTERFACE=ens4\nIFINDEX=3
device -> ../../../virtio1

-- sys/devices/virtual/net/docker0/ --
type=1
ifindex=4
iflink=4
flags=0x1003
carrier=1
carrier_changes=2
operstate=up
speed=10000
duplex=unknown
address=02:00:00:00:05:04
mtu=1500
uevent=DEVTYPE=bridge\nINTERFACE=docker0\nIFINDEX=4
bridge/forward_delay=1500
brif/veth1a2b3c4
lower_veth1a2b3c4

-- sys/devices/virtual/net/lo/ --
type=772
ifindex=1
iflink=1
flags=0x9
carrier=1
carrier_changes=0
operstate=unknown
address=00:00:00:00:00:00
mtu=65536
uevent=INTERFACE=lo\nIFINDEX=1

-- sys/devices/virtual/net/tailscale0/ --
type=65534
ifindex=5
iflink=5
flags=0x10d1
carrier=1
carrier_changes=0
operstate=unknown
mtu=1280
uevent=DEVTYPE=tun\nINTERFACE=tailscale0\nIFINDEX=5

-- sys/devices/virtual/net/veth1a2b3c4/ --
type=1
ifindex=6
iflink=5
flags=0x1103
carrier=1
carrier_changes=2
operstate=up
speed=10000
duplex=full
address=02:00:00:00:05:06
mtu=1500
uevent=INTERFACE=veth1a2b3c4\nIFINDEX=6
brport/state=3
upper_docker0
master
